title: Snake's Embrace
body:
Syntax: perform snakes embrace <target>

Description: An illusion of snakes that can weaken the target's outgoing damage.  Its weakening reduces outgoing damage by 15%. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 62-71. 65% chance to inflict weakened. The effect lasts 24 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 30. Costs 28 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
